abstract: This study is PhaseⅠstudy to examine tolerability and safety of ONO-7475 in combination with ONO-4538 and gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel (GnP), the standard of care, and safety of ONO-7475 in combination with GnP in patients with metastatic pancreatic cancer as first-line treatment
title: A PhaseⅠStudy of ONO-7475 in Combination With ONO-4538 and Gemcitabine Plus Nab-paclitaxel (GnP), the Standard of Care, and ONO-7475 in Combination With GnP in Patients With Pancreatic Cancer

trial.eligibility_text:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Patient with metastatic pancreatic cancer
2. Patients have an ECOG performance status of 0 to 1
3. Patients with a life expectancy of at least 6 months

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Patients are unable to swallow oral medications
2. Patients with severe complication
